entities.summary: World of Discoveries in Porto, Portugal, tells the story of Portuguese exploration through a ride and walk-through displays.
entities.description: At Porto’s World of Discoveries, a compact combination of ride and walk-through displays presents Portuguese exploration as a family story. It is best suited to children around six to twelve who enjoy being carried through scenes rather than a conventional museum visit. Check current opening and individual activity rules before going.
entities.whyWorthwhile: World of Discoveries in Porto makes Portuguese exploration accessible to children through a compact ride-and-walk-through storytelling experience.

entities.summary: The Portuguese School of Equestrian Art’s full gala in Lisbon presents trained Lusitano horses, historic costume, music and court riding exercises.
entities.description: Book the full gala at Picadeiro Henrique Calado in Lisbon’s Belém area to see Portugal’s court riding tradition as a complete performance. Highly trained Alter Real Lusitano horses perform formal exercises accompanied by music and historic costumes. The main appeal is visual; programme information and commentary add context. Morning training sessions are a smaller, different visit. Some seating areas have access limitations, so confirm the appropriate sector when booking.
entities.whyWorthwhile: The Portuguese School of Equestrian Art’s Lisbon gala brings skilled horsemanship, historic costume and music together in a full court-style performance.

entities.summary: Oceanário de Lisboa in Lisbon, Portugal, is an aquarium centred on a large ocean display and presentations of marine ecosystems.
entities.description: Lisbon’s Oceanário de Lisboa uses its central ocean aquarium and surrounding ecosystem presentation to make marine life the focus of a well-designed visit. The arrangement of the spaces is part of the appeal, helping a group explore the displays together. It suits children around five and older through adults. Check current opening and visitor arrangements before going.
entities.whyWorthwhile: Oceanário de Lisboa combines a central ocean aquarium with well-designed spaces presenting marine ecosystems, making it a strong choice for a Lisbon aquarium visit.
